integrity: The sharp bound follows from the exact Pareto tail formula and two strict elementary logarithmic inequalities; the asymptotic follows from a direct Taylor expansion. Supplementary numerical checks are not used as proof.
limitations: Restricted to Pareto type-I laws with finite variance and the one-standard-deviation central interval; no arbitrary-radius or distribution-free assertion is made.
title: Sharp one-sigma central-mass infimum for finite-variance Pareto laws
